description: Section 6: only outputs with the aggregate shape are scoped. A once producer's output reads the same from a per_device consumer, including one that happens to carry a devices list with no device_id.
notes: Derived from section 6, which defines the aggregate by devices[].device_id and devices[].output and says templates may rely only on that pair, so an ordinary step whose output happens to carry a devices list must not be mistaken for a fan-out. Nashira requires the device_id to be present before it treats an output as a fan-out (VariableResolver.IsAggregate); the oracle was not consulted for this case.
